prompt: Use e.getClickCount() in mouseClicked to sort clicks into singles, doubles and rapid (three or more), and show the kind of the last click in a label.
explanation: A single mouseClicked method handles every kind of click because the MouseEvent itself carries the click count -- Swing decides what counts as "quick succession" for you. Branching on getClickCount() is how menus distinguish select-on-single from open-on-double. Treating 3 or more as one case avoids an unbounded chain of else-if branches for very fast clicking.
hints: new MouseAdapter() { public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent e) { ... } } lets you override just the one method you need.
e.getClickCount() returns an int; compare it with 1 and 2 and let the else branch cover everything larger.
Remember to update the kind label in every branch, not just the counters.
